full_dataset_size: This IS the full dataset: the repo holds one 2.9 KB ics (13 events, one Austrian listing, Jan-Jun 2019) plus 5 KB PHP and a vendored eluceo/ical library (repo size 31 KB). No larger data exists upstream; the tool only produces more data when run against a host's own private feed URLs.
description: A tiny self-hosted PHP script (icalmerger.php, eluceo/ical) that unions a vacation-rental host's Airbnb / Booking.com / Atraveo iCal availability feeds into one calendar, plus one committed output file ics/allservices.ics for a single Austrian rental (kuenstlerzimmer.at). Grain is one VEVENT per blocked date range (DTSTART/DTEND, all-day) with the source channel in SUMMARY; 13 events covering Jan-Jun 2019, 59 blocked nights, but only 4 events carry a channel label (ATRAVEO) and the other 9 have SUMMARY set to their own start date and overlap the first four, so the file reads as a test/demo output of the merge rather than a clean booking record. For ABNB it is a worked example of the per-listing channel-tagged occupancy record (channel mix, length of stay) that a host-side iCal panel would produce, and documents the iCal-feed mechanism as a non-scraping route to Booking/Vrbo/Atraveo availability data (gaps 2 and 9); it carries no signal on its own.
issues: No licence file (all rights reserved by default) - reuse of the code or the ics needs a human decision; the ics is a real host's (kuenstlerzimmer.at) calendar, so treat as personal data even though it is public. Data is a single listing, 13 events, 2019 only, and 9 of 13 events have malformed SUMMARY (a date string, not a channel) and duplicate/overlap the labelled events - not a usable time series. The tool was NOT run (needs private feed URLs). Last push Jan 2020, effectively abandoned.
